individual_weapons.name: Individual Weapons
individual_weapons.description: Personal firearms and portable weapons for individual use.

assault_rifles.name: Assault Rifles
assault_rifles.description: Automatic rifles for infantry, often with selective fire modes.

sniper_rifles.name: Sniper Rifles
sniper_rifles.description: High-precision rifles for engaging distant targets.

anti_tank.name: Anti-Tank Weapons
anti_tank.description: Guided missiles and recoilless systems for defeating armored vehicles.

collective_weapons.name: Collective Weapons
collective_weapons.description: Heavy weapons and systems requiring a crew to operate.

tanks.name: Tanks
tanks.description: Armored fighting vehicles with a main gun for direct engagement.

fighter_jets.name: Fighter Jets
fighter_jets.description: Aircraft designed for air-to-air combat and ground attack.

air_defense.name: Air Defense Systems
air_defense.description: Surface-to-air missiles and integrated air-defense networks against aircraft, drones, and missiles.

helicopters.name: Combat Helicopters
helicopters.description: Attack and multi-role helicopters for close air support, anti-armor, and transport assault.

naval_vessels.name: Naval Vessels
naval_vessels.description: Surface combatants and submarines for sea control, blockade, and littoral operations.

apc_ifv.name: APC / IFV
apc_ifv.description: Armored personnel carriers and infantry fighting vehicles for mechanized infantry mobility and fire support.

robotics_ai_weapons.name: Robotics / AI-controlled / Remote-controlled Weapons
robotics_ai_weapons.description: Weapon systems operated without a human on board or with significant AI assistance.

drones.name: Drones
drones.description: Unmanned aerial vehicles for surveillance, reconnaissance, and combat.

artillery.name: Artillery
artillery.description: Crew-served cannons and rockets for long-range indirect fire support.

ballistic_missiles.name: Ballistic Missiles
ballistic_missiles.description: Surface-to-surface ballistic missiles for theater and strategic strike.

cruise_missiles.name: Cruise Missiles
cruise_missiles.description: Low-flying guided missiles for precision strike against land and sea targets.

unconventional_weapons.name: Unconventional Weapons
unconventional_weapons.description: Weapons not falling under standard military categories, including improvised or highly specific systems.

improvised_explosive_devices.name: Improvised Explosive Devices (IEDs)
improvised_explosive_devices.description: Homemade bombs used in guerrilla warfare and terrorism.

chemical_weapons.name: Chemical Weapons
chemical_weapons.description: Toxic chemicals and their delivery systems designed to cause death or injury.

nerve_agents.name: Nerve Agents
nerve_agents.description: Chemicals that disrupt the nervous system, leading to paralysis and death.

vx.description: Persistent and extremely toxic nerve agent.

chlorine.description: A toxic gas used as a choking agent.

mustard_agent.description: A blister agent that causes severe skin, eye, and respiratory irritation.

biological_weapons.name: Biological Weapons
biological_weapons.description: Pathogens or toxins used to incapacitate or kill humans, animals, or plants.

anthrax.name: Anthrax
anthrax.description: A bacterium that can be weaponized as a powder for inhalation.

nuclear_weapons.name: Nuclear Weapons
nuclear_weapons.description: Weapons of mass destruction deriving destructive force from nuclear reactions.

fission_weapons.name: Fission Weapons
fission_weapons.description: Atomic bombs using a chain reaction to release a massive amount of energy.

threshold_state_program.name: Threshold State Program
threshold_state_program.description: A state with the technical capacity to build nuclear weapons but has not made a political decision to do so.
